February 5, 2025

# Northwind releases 2024 annual report

PORTSMITH—Northwind Community Credit Union released its annual report today.

- 280 Northwind employees used Volunteer Day in 2024 to serve local nonprofits.

Northwind Community Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative. It has 12 branch office locations and 300 employees.
